title: A Culinary Journey Through TWIST Rooftop Restaurant
content:
Perched on the 19th floor of Royal Phuket City Hotel, TWIST Rooftop Restaurant & Bar offers an unforgettable dining experience that combines stunning panoramic views with exceptional cuisine.

The View

As you step onto the rooftop terrace, you are greeted with a 360-degree panorama of Phuket Town, the Andaman Sea, and the surrounding mountains. The sunset hours are particularly magical, as the sky transforms into a canvas of orange, pink, and purple hues.

The Menu

Our executive chef has crafted a menu that celebrates both Thai traditions and international influences. Signature dishes include:

  • Grilled Andaman Tiger Prawns with lemongrass butter
  • Wagyu Beef Tataki with Thai herbs
  • Traditional Tom Yum with fresh local seafood

The Cocktails

Our mixologists have created a selection of signature cocktails inspired by Phukets heritage and tropical flavors.

Before arranging an evening here, use our rooftop dinner in Phuket Town planning guide to prepare questions about the date, table, meal preferences and journey.
